meta.source: Galaxy-view concept art + Star Bazaar interface reference (in-game labels)

tokens.name: void-000
tokens.usage: Deepest space behind the starfield; screen edges and vignette.

tokens.name: void-100
tokens.usage: Default screen background under nebula and stars.

tokens.name: panel-100
tokens.usage: Glass panel fill (planet / route panel, notification board, top bar). Always over void, never over a bright nebula core.

tokens.name: panel-200
tokens.usage: Raised fill inside a panel: hovered rows, connection rows, finance rows.

tokens.name: panel-300
tokens.usage: Selected rows, filled storage, pressed keys.

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside panels; inactive orbit paths.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Panel borders, control outlines, orbit paths.

tokens.name: line-300
tokens.usage: Selected orbit, focused control border, locked markers (3:1 on void).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on void and panel fills.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary labels (type lines, section captions, deltas) on void and panels.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary metadata, key hints, locked items; 4.6:1 on void-100, use 12px+.

tokens.name: star-core
tokens.usage: Hot centre of stars and the selection reticle glow.

tokens.name: star-warm
tokens.usage: Sun halo, selected-object accent, primary button, focus ring. The one decorative accent.

tokens.name: nebula-dust
tokens.usage: Warm dust lanes in backgrounds; never behind text without a panel.

tokens.name: commodity-energy
tokens.usage: Energy: its icon, stock bars and route lines. Never decoration.

tokens.name: commodity-food
tokens.usage: Food: its icon, stock bars and route lines. Never decoration.

tokens.name: signal-info
tokens.usage: Mission hints, tutorial lines, and the Research skill branch.

tokens.name: signal-good
tokens.usage: Net income above zero, Running, Learned. Pair with a + sign or a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: signal-warn
tokens.usage: "Waiting for room.", Paused, storage nearly full.

tokens.name: signal-bad
tokens.usage: Blocked routes, losses, negative net, Remove on hover. Pair with a − sign or a word.

tokens.name: cash
tokens.usage: Cash totals and the goal progress bar. A warmer ink, not a hue.

styles.name: map-faction
styles.usage: System names floating on the map, wide-tracked, ink-muted or ink-subtle.

styles.name: map-label
styles.usage: Planet and route labels next to their marker.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Planet / route panel heading, event title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Rows, notices, effect lines, button labels.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Cash, income, expenses, stock: tabular figures line up across rows.

styles.name: readout-sm
styles.usage: Cycle numbers, per-cycle rates, key caps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-number gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related items in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, label offset from a map marker.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between panel sections; screen gutter to HUD.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between resource groups in the top bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Key caps, storage bars, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, nav rail, panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, popups, the run-state control.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Planets, reticles, pills.

tokens.name: glow-star
tokens.usage: Halo on selected stars and the selection reticle.

tokens.name: glow-atmo
tokens.usage: Atmosphere rim on terran worlds.

tokens.name: panel-lift
tokens.usage: Floating panels over the map.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter radius behind panel-100 glass.
